answer.observations: Default run has UDP at 979 Mbps and TCP at 0 with only 3 retransmissions, while the reverse link is idle, so TCP is not making progress despite full forward-link utilization.

whys.result: UDP is offered 2 Gbps on a 1 Gbps link, l1_drops=911591, and tcp_goodput_bps=0.
whys.guess: The FIFO queue is full from UDP excess, so TCP packets are tail-dropped before TCP can establish or deliver data.

whys.result: tcp_retrans=3 with zero delivered TCP payload and zero reverse-link utilization.
whys.guess: TCP is retransmitting lost connection or data segments after a long RTO rather than making progress.

hypotheses.text: In r001 probe, tcp_inflight max is 0, showing TCP never has bytes sent and unacknowledged during the measured interval.
In r001 probe, tcp_rto_ms max is greater than 1000 ms, showing TCP is stuck on a long retransmission timer.

answer.observations: TCP cwnd is nonzero (14480 at t=2, 1448 for most measured interval) while tcp_bps=0 and l1_util_back=0, so it is unclear whether TCP has unacknowledged bytes in flight, is stuck on RTO, or never gets an RTT sample.

whys.result: tcp_cwnd is 14480 at t=2, falls to 1448 by t=2.1, and returns to 14480 at t=10.1 while tcp_bps remains 0.
whys.guess: TCP's initial window is lost immediately and the flow is not making progress; the later cwnd value likely reflects a new connection attempt or reset rather than successful congestion control.

hypotheses.text: In r001 probe, tcp_rtt_ms max is 0, showing TCP never received an ACK from which to sample RTT.

answer.observations: r001 shows tcp_ssthresh min 2896 and l1_wait_ms max 1.144 ms, but it is not yet known whether TCP ever had unacknowledged bytes or a nonzero receive window while getting no RTT/ACKs.

whys.result: r001 has tcp_ssthresh min 2896, cwnd collapse from 14480 to 1448, and l1_wait_ms max 1.144 ms.
whys.guess: TCP sent an initial window and reduced cwnd/ssthresh after loss; the forward FIFO is full at about 100 packets, so TCP packets are dropped before ACKs rather than the receiver advertising a zero window.

hypotheses.text: In r001 probe, tcp_inflight max is greater than 0, showing TCP had bytes sent and unacknowledged during the measured interval.
In r001 probe, tcp_rwnd max is greater than 0, showing the sender knew a nonzero receive window.

drop.why: tcp_inflight max 0 alone cannot distinguish tail-drop from no-send/zero-window; H4/H5 test the needed distinction.
